lines.zh: 我摆着长鳍在树根间穿。
lines.en: I weave my long fins through the roots.

lines.zh: 红树林的水很浑，我照游。
lines.en: The mangrove water is murky; I swim anyway.
One twist and I have turned.
My fins trail behind me like banners.
I drift along the water weeds.
My passing stirs up the muddy bottom.
I slip between two mangrove roots.
I swim slowly, fins spread wide.
The swamp water is lukewarm.
One flick and I am in the shade.
I push forward against the current.

lines.zh: 红树的气根挂住我的鳍。
lines.en: The mangrove roots snag my fins.

lines.zh: 我绕着树根转了个小圈。
lines.en: I loop a small circle around a root.
I kick aside the sunken leaves.

lines.zh: 我从一片落叶底下穿过去
lines.en: I slip beneath a fallen leaf.

lines.zh: 水流一急，我就收鳍贴着泥
lines.en: When the current quickens, I fold my fins low.

lines.zh: 我绕着红树的根转了个弯
lines.en: I curve around a mangrove root.

lines.zh: 浑水里，我只看得清三步
lines.en: In this murk I see only three steps ahead.
I hang beside the weeds without moving.
My fins open and close.
Something tiny stirs in the mud.
I watch the flecks of light on the surface.
I let out a single, slow bubble.
It is quiet under the roots.
I fold my fins halfway in.
Something is drinking at the surface.
I turn a small circle and stop.
The swamp smells close and sweet.
I wait for a bug to fall in.

lines.zh: 我的颜色在水里很显眼。
lines.en: My color stands out in this water.

lines.zh: 我躲进一片叶子的影里。
lines.en: I tuck into the shadow of a leaf.
I am in no hurry all day long.
You have stepped into my swamp.
I look up at you from underwater.
Your shadow falls over my fins.
You are much thicker than these roots.
I spread my fins at you; stay back.
You crouch at the water's edge.

lines.zh: 我的颜色比你的衣服亮。
lines.en: My colors outshine your clothes.
Your hand stirs the water.
I keep my eyes on your fingers.
No net; I will leave on my own.
One hit and my health drops.
I flipped over, fins in a mess.
Three hearts; two hits and I am gone.
A corner of my red scales came off.
The water is red, and it is mine.
It hurts; I dive into a root gap.
Who stepped on me? I cannot see.
I tremble and cannot swim straight.
I cannot take much more of this.
Give me a moment and I can swim.
A bug has fallen onto the water.
I drift half an inch closer.
The thing in your hand is wriggling.
My mouth is small; I take small bites.
Drop it; do not pinch it.

lines.zh: 红树林的水浑，我不吃亏。
lines.en: Mangrove water is murky. I don't lose here.
Food is scarce in this swamp.
Put the bait on a leaf.
I circle once before daring to near.
One bite, then back under the roots.
One step and you turned the water over.
I am this small; do not step on me.
The wave spun me around.
My fin got knocked askew.
I dive under the mangrove roots.
You hit the water, not me.
I back off, then drift back.
The mud is all stirred up.
A tail flick splashes your face.
After the bump, this water is still mine.
Fins spread, I signal to her.

lines.zh: 沼泽里遇见同色不容易。
lines.en: Meeting my own color here is rare.
I circle her with fins fully spread.
She is a bit smaller, and prettier.
We rest side by side under the roots.
I am fierce to others, not to her.
The weeds can hide us both.

lines.zh: 我给她让了最好的位置。
lines.en: I give her the best spot.
Her fin brushes against mine.
We drift slowly toward deeper water.
My mouth is too small to hold it.
I nudge that fallen leaf.
It is bigger than me; never mind.
I only pick up what I can swallow.
I spat out that grain of sand.
I push it along with my snout.
I test whatever floats past.
I take the crumbs you dropped.
I cannot swim while carrying things.
I let go and it sinks.
A large shadow moves in the water.
That is no bug; that is a fish.
Something shifts behind the roots.
My fins stiffen; I am ready to flee.

lines.zh: 它那么大，我的鳍却先张开。
lines.en: It's so much bigger, yet my fins flare first.
I retreat into the thick weeds.
A splash and I am on guard.
That thing is heading my way.
I first check how many eyes it has.
This is wrong; I must hide.
It circles in; I press to the bottom.
I slip behind a leaf.
Its mouth opens and closes.

lines.zh: 它的鳍一抖，我就跟着转。
lines.en: When its fin twitches, I turn with it.
When it nears, I slide sideways.
The mud color hides half of me.
I freeze, not even my fins move.
It has lost track of me.
I watch it through a gap in the roots.
I wait until it is gone to come out.
I peck off one of its scales.
This small, I can only nip.
One sweep of its tail washes me away.
I bite the edge of its fin.
If I cannot win, I run.
I butt it once and leave.
My teeth are as small as sand.
Its hide is too thick to bite.
I only want to guard these roots.
After biting I hide in the weeds.

lines.zh: 我在红树林的浅水里出现。
lines.en: I appear in the mangrove shallows.
The mud stirs; I flick my tail away.
The swamp water lifts me up.
I spread my fins and my colors brighten.
There is just room for me between the roots.

lines.zh: 我生来就守这一小片水。
lines.en: I was born to guard this little patch.

lines.zh: 水面上的光刺了我一下。
lines.en: The light on the surface stings my eyes.
I circle my own small territory.
I am the only betta here.
I slip into the weeds and begin to wait.

lines.zh: 水一热，我的鳍缩成一团。
lines.en: When the water warms, my fins curl tight.

lines.zh: 我被甩到泥地上，喘不上气。
lines.en: I got flung onto mud, gasping.
Drowning in water is embarrassing.
A blast; my fins clamp shut.
My fins are flared. Do not test me.

lines.zh: 一股怪力把我按在泥里。
lines.en: A strange force pins me to the mud.
I am starved down to skin.

lines.zh: 雷落进沼泽，我浑身发麻。
lines.en: Lightning hit the swamp; I went numb.

lines.zh: 虚空没有水草，我无处藏。
lines.en: No weeds in the void; nowhere to hide.
